description: Delegate tasks to sub-agents that run in sessions of their own
title: Subagents

settings.label: Maximum nesting depth
settings.desc: 0 disables delegation; 1 allows direct subagents only; 2 allows subagents to delegate once. Manage custom agents with /subagents.

settings.label: Allow nested delegation
settings.desc: When off, only the main agent can delegate. Maximum depth still applies.

settings.label: Maximum concurrent subagents
settings.desc: Global limit across sessions, including nested agents. Extra calls fail instead of waiting; 0 means unlimited.

settings.label: Default provider
settings.desc: Configured provider entry name; blank uses the session provider. Named agents can override this.

settings.label: Default model
settings.desc: Model ID for the selected provider; blank uses its configured model. Requires request-hook model support.

settings.label: Default instructions
settings.desc: Prepended to the normal system prompt; blank uses the built-in subagent role. Use /subagents for custom prompts.

settings.label: Allowed tools
settings.desc: Comma-separated tool names. Blank or * allows all; none or [] allows none. Include subagent to permit nested delegation.
